summary: ITER181.A.3 Workspace Action Hub Refactor — VERIFIED PASS on live frontend at https://content-hub-pro-22.preview.emergentagent.com after admin login. Hub mounts at [data-testid='dashboard-workspace-hub'] with data-hub-mode='setup' (seed tenant SCENARIO A: leads=0, prospects=0, journeys=0). Quick Actions DOM order is EXACTLY the spec for Scenario A: [quick-action-new-contact, quick-action-media-library, quick-action-material-view, quick-action-editorial-calendar, quick-action-blueprint-chameleon]. Visible labels match spec verbatim: 'Nuovo Contatto', 'Media Library', 'Material View', 'Calendario Editoriale', 'Blueprint Chameleon'. FORBIDDEN cards absent: [quick-action-team]=0, [quick-action-new-relationship]=0. Topbar CTA [data-testid='topbar-new-relationship-cta'] present (prospects=0 branch) with visible text='Nuovo Contatto' (NOT 'Nuova Relazione'). Copy audit on dashboard body.innerText: 'Nuova Relazione' = ABSENT, 'Nuovo Contatto' = PRESENT. Activation steps all 5 render: identity/blueprint/team/market/workspace. KPI hero all 4 render: kpi-leads/kpi-prospects/kpi-customers/kpi-active-journeys. 'Design Journey attive' section and 'Attività relazionali' timeline present. Click [quick-action-new-contact] opens NewRelationshipModal (overlay [new-relationship-modal-overlay] visible with title 'Da dove vuoi iniziare?' and Lead/Prospect/Cliente choice — image confirmed). Static source audit on /app/frontend/src/components/activation/WorkspaceActionHub.jsx confirms getQuickActionsForState(biz) correctly maps the 4 scenarios A/B/C/D in priority order (journeys>0 → D, prospects>0 → C, leads>0 → B, else → A); each action object has a route field pointing to existing App.js routes (/library, /library/materials, /moodboards, /blueprint/editorial-calendar, /settings, /workspace/projects, /relations/leads, modal:new-relationship). Ready mode label 'Workspace Operativo' present in source at line 271 inside HubReady branch; banned strings 'Workspace Ready' and 'Setup Workspace' as visible label inside HubReady are ABSENT (eyebrow 'Setup Workspace' lives only in HubSetup branch — by design). Topbar.jsx PrimaryCta correctly resolves label via t('nav.new_contact', null, 'Nuovo Contatto') and i18n it-IT.json has key nav.new_contact='Nuovo Contatto'. Route audit static via App.js confirmed by previous iteration (iteration_167) — all routes resolve.

issues: Modal eyebrow text still reads 'CRM · NUOVA RELAZIONE' (uppercase) and i18n key new_relationship_eyebrow = 'CRM · Nuova relazione'. This is INSIDE the modal triggered by [quick-action-new-contact], not on the dashboard chrome — so it does NOT violate the spec ('label visibili' on dashboard). However, if E1 wants full lexical alignment to 'Nuovo Contatto', the modal eyebrow should also be relabeled. Out of scope for ITER181.A.3 but flagging for completeness.

action_items: (Optional, out-of-scope) Consider rewording NewRelationshipModal eyebrow from 'CRM · Nuova relazione' to 'CRM · Nuovo contatto' for full lexical alignment across the user journey (currently the dashboard CTA says 'Nuovo Contatto' but the resulting modal still says 'Nuova relazione' as eyebrow text).

(Pre-existing, out-of-scope) i18n keys missing in it-IT.json: auth.login.eyebrow/email_label/email_placeholder/password_label/password_placeholder/cta + auth.access.quote/quote_author/need_help/support/support_email + auth.login.hero_image/brand_logo + nav.editorial_copy_cms/admin_languages/blueprint_admin. (Pre-existing, out-of-scope) React warning persists: 'Cannot update a component (LocalizationOverlay) while rendering a different component (LoginPage/Sidebar)' — setState-in-render in LocalizationOverlay. Documented since prior iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: WorkspaceActionHub.jsx is well-structured: action catalogue (A) is centralised, getQuickActionsForState(biz) is pure and easy to test, mode dispatch (setup/ready/contextual) is clean. Both HubSetup and HubReady consume the same priority function — single source of truth.

Route field uses sentinel 'modal:new-relationship' for actions that should open the modal — consistent contract with useSmartCtaRouter. opts.choice='prospect' for newJourney correctly drives the prospect path inside the modal.
Scenario A returns 5 actions, Scenarios B/C return 4 actions, Scenario D returns 5 actions — consistent with the spec; the priority function fully matches the matrix in the problem statement.

Topbar.jsx PrimaryCta correctly switches data-testid (topbar-new-relationship-cta vs topbar-new-journey-cta) based on prospects count — keeps backward-compat with existing selectors while delivering the new copy.

Minor: i18n key nav.new_relationship='Nuova Relazione' (it-IT.json line 514) is still present in the bundle — used only by deprecated codepaths; safe to keep for now but mark for cleanup in a follow-up sprint.

Minor: Action catalogue defines both 'materials' (Materiali, used in Scenario D) and 'materialView' (Material View, used in Scenarios A/C) pointing to the same route /library/materials. This is intentional (different label per scenario) but the duplication is worth a comment in source — currently undocumented.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 acceptance items PASS on live Scenario A; B/C/D verified statically against source

context_for_next_testing_agent: ITER181.A.3 fully verified. Live runtime confirms Scenario A. Scenarios B/C/D logic is verified via static reading of getQuickActionsForState in /app/frontend/src/components/activation/WorkspaceActionHub.jsx (priority: journeys>0 → D, prospects>0 → C, leads>0 → B, else → A). If E1 wants to live-test B/C/D, the recommended path is: (a) seed a lead via POST /api/public/journeys/initiate to get into Scenario B, then (b) promote lead→prospect to enter Scenario C, then (c) create a journey to enter Scenario D. Backend invariant during this sprint. The only minor copy gap is the modal eyebrow 'CRM · Nuova relazione' which is OUTSIDE the dashboard chrome and OUTSIDE the spec scope; flagged for E1 awareness only.
